title: Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end physical-layer learning replaces separate modulation, coding, and detection operations with an autoencoder (AE) that consists of a jointly trained encoder-decoder pair at the transmitter and the receiver. This paper studies AI-native communications with AEs and quantifies the sensitivity to training-test mismatch in channel models. Models trained only on an AWGN channel achieve low bit error rates (BERs) under matched conditions but degrade severely on Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. To reduce the time and energy required to adapt to new channel conditions, we propose a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that starts from an AWGN-pretrained system and fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the remainder. translated_title: 基于迁移学习的AI原生自编码器通信的频谱自适应
translated_abstract: 端到端物理层学习用自编码器（AE）取代了独立的调制、编码和检测操作，该自编码器由发射机和接收机处联合训练的编码器-解码器对组成。本文研究了基于自编码器的AI原生通信，并量化了其对信道模型训练-测试不匹配的敏感性。仅在AWGN信道上训练的模型在匹配条件下可实现低误码率（BER），但在带有实际前端损伤的瑞利衰落信道下性能严重退化。为减少适应新信道条件所需的时间和能耗，我们提出了一种低延迟的迁移学习流程，该流程从AWGN预训练系统出发，仅微调发射机和接收机中的一小部分层，同时冻结其余部分。我们进一步将层选择形式化为一个预算受限的优化问题，以识别在自适应过程中最具信息量的待更新参数。
tldr: 提出了一种低延迟迁移学习方法，通过仅微调少量网络层即可将AWGN预训练的AI原生自编码器通信系统快速适应至新信道条件，并将层选择建模为预算受限的优化问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a low-latency transfer-learning approach that rapidly adapts AWGN-pretrained AI-native autoencoder communications to new channel conditions by fine-tuning only a small subset of layers, with layer selection formulated as a budget-constrained optimization problem.
